blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team is set to challenge on Monday the claims of forensic financial analyst Alexander Cabrera. Cabrera is the expert witness presented by the prosecution to prove Duterte’s alleged hidden wealth. During his direct examination on October 9, Cabrera, citing his report, said that Duterte and her spouse, Atty. Manases Carpio, had a total unexplained wealth of P817.87 million from 2022 to 2025.
